content:
Chem Progress is a chemical company based in San Giuliano Milanese (MI), at Via Romagna, 9 – 20098, Italy, operating in one of the country’s most dynamic industrial areas. Situated near Milan and its well-established chemical and manufacturing ecosystem, the company benefits from strong logistics connections and access to a broad network of customers, partners, and technical resources. Chem Progress presents itself as a modern, solutions-oriented organization focused on supporting industrial clients with chemical products and related services designed to meet evolving market requirements.

With an emphasis on reliability, technical competence, and continuous improvement, Chem Progress works to deliver consistent quality while maintaining close attention to safety and operational standards. The company’s approach is rooted in understanding application needs and translating them into practical, efficient outcomes—whether that involves product selection, formulation support, or supply continuity. In a sector where performance, compliance, and traceability are increasingly important, Chem Progress aims to be a dependable point of reference for businesses seeking responsive service and clear, professional collaboration.

Located at Via Romagna, 9 in San Giuliano (MI), Chem Progress is positioned to serve both local and wider markets, combining the advantages of an Italian industrial base with a forward-looking mindset. Through ongoing investment in know-how and customer relationships, the company seeks to contribute to its clients’ productivity and sustainability goals, building long-term partnerships grounded in trust and results.
